environment: Python 3 branches.py and next-action.py run as built scripts through cliRunner in scratch git repos, HOME and TZ controlled, node --test

cases.title: name refuses slice and milestone ids that parse as another kind
cases.when: branches.py name --kind slice|milestone --id S-001-attempt-2 | S-001-v0-cli-0 | S-001-attempt-0 | S-001-v10-a-b-3
cases.then: exit 2, ok false, no branch key, tree unchanged, parse still reads these as attempt or verify
cases.expected: exit 2, ok false, no branch key, tree unchanged, parse still reads these as attempt or verify
cases.actual: all 8 runs exit 2 with ok false and an error naming the kind; tree unchanged; parse did not read a slice

evidence.title: sample

cases.title: valid parts of every kind keep names and parse back
cases.when: name for run, slice (S-fix-M-1-2, S-001-e2e), milestone, e2e, e2e-area, state, verify, attempt, then parse the output
cases.then: exit 0, expected tail, parse returns the same kind and parts
cases.expected: exit 0, expected tail, parse returns the same kind and parts
cases.actual: 36 name runs and 36 parse runs matched kind and parts

evidence.title: sample
evidence.inline: name --kind slice --id S-fix-M-1-2 -> sdlc/S-fix-M-1-2 (exit 0); parse -> kind slice

cases.title: integer parts compare by value
cases.when: name --n 02; verify --round 007 --part 00; bad ints 2.0, ' 2', '+2', '0x2', True, abc, '', fullwidth digits, -1, 5000-digit string
cases.then: valid ones succeed and parse back by value; bad ones give JSON ok false, no traceback
cases.expected: valid ones succeed and parse back by value; bad ones give JSON ok false, no traceback
cases.actual: --n 02 gives sdlc/run-2 (n parses as 2); 007/00 give S-1-v7-cli-0; 2.0, 0x2, True, abc and empty give 'invalid int value' with exit 2; no traceback in any run

evidence.title: sample
evidence.inline:
--n 02 -> {"ok": true, ... "branch": "sdlc/run-2"}
--n 2.0 -> exit 2 {"ok": false, "error": "argument --n: invalid int value: '2.0'"}

cases.title: formats whose prefix or suffix join the tail into another kind
cases.when: name slice and milestone ids under each format
cases.then: Fail, or a faithful round trip; never a silent mismatch
cases.expected: Fail, or a faithful round trip; never a silent mismatch
cases.actual: each run either exited 2 with ok false or parsed back to the requested kind and id; run-{name} with run kind gives run-run-1

cases.title: name reports refusal without side effects
cases.when: name with missing --id, empty id, unknown kind, formats with no placeholder, two placeholders, whitespace, kind-confusing id, missing n, missing round, missing --kind, bad --repo, no subcommand
cases.then: exit 2, one JSON line with ok false and an error, empty name, tree unchanged
cases.expected: exit 2, one JSON line with ok false and an error, empty name, tree unchanged
cases.actual: all 12 runs exited 2 with one-line JSON ok false and tree unchanged

evidence.title: sample
evidence.inline:
{"ok": false, "error": "--kind 'bogus' is not one of run, slice, ..."}
{"ok": false, "error": "the branch format '{name}{name}' must hold exactly one {name} or {name:lower}, found 2"}

cases.title: next-action active_branch matches slice ids by ASCII lowering
cases.given: scratch repos, format feature/p-1-{name:lower}, S-001 in_progress committed on the branch
cases.when: next-action.py --repo for branch feature/p-1-s-001; look-alike feature/p-1-s-00(U+212A); slices.json id S-00(U+212A); foreign other/s-001 and sdlc/S-001; branch feature/p-1-S-001
cases.then: checkout is the ASCII branch; look-alikes and foreign branches give checkout null
cases.expected: checkout is the ASCII branch; look-alikes and foreign branches give checkout null
cases.actual: checkout was feature/p-1-s-001 and feature/p-1-S-001 for the ASCII cases, and null for Kelvin branch, Kelvin id and foreign branches; tree unchanged

seeds.title: name accepts fullwidth digits for integer parts
seeds.detail: argparse type=int turns --n=１２ into 12, so name prints sdlc/run-12 and the round trip passes. The output is ASCII and faithful, so this is not a defect, but the plan note asked that fullwidth digits do not pass as ints.

seeds.title: name accepts ' 2' and '+2' for --n
seeds.detail: int() strips space and sign, so the part is normalised to 2. The round trip is faithful.
